core_image.text: 今からまもなく・すぐに
core_image.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 240 160"><rect width="240" height="160" fill="white"/><g fill="none" stroke="black" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><line x1="20" y1="80" x2="220" y2="80"/><line x1="80" y1="70" x2="80" y2="90"/><circle cx="120" cy="80" r="8"/><line x1="84" y1="50" x2="116" y2="50"/><polyline points="109,46.2 116,50 109,53.8"/></g><text x="80" y="110" font-size="11" text-anchor="middle" fill="black" stroke="none">いま</text><text x="160" y="30" font-size="11" text-anchor="middle" fill="black" stroke="none">まもなく</text></svg>

etymology: 古い英語 sōna(すぐに) → まもなく・すぐに → as soon as=〜するとすぐ

en_definitions.text: in a short time from now; quickly.

cautions: as soon as S V=〜するとすぐに(未来のことでも現在形)
as soon as possible=できるだけ早く(ASAP)
sooner or later=遅かれ早かれ
No sooner had S done than ...=〜するやいなや

examples.label: すぐに
examples.en: Call me as soon as you get home.
examples.ja: 家に着いたらすぐ電話して。

examples.label: できるだけ早く
examples.en: Please reply as soon as possible.
examples.ja: できるだけ早くお返事ください。

examples.label: 遅かれ早かれ
examples.en: Sooner or later, he will find out.
examples.ja: 遅かれ早かれ彼は知るだろう。

examples.label: やいなや
examples.en: No sooner had I arrived than it began to rain.
examples.ja: 私が着くやいなや雨が降りだした。

check_points: as soon as のあとが現在形になることがわかるか

exam.note: as soon as、No sooner ... than が出る。
